integrity: The source endpoint root bracket and derivative bounds were inspected directly. The new coefficients follow analytically from the exact value of I(1,rho), the source identity for I_mu(1,1), direct differentiation giving I_{mu,rho}(1,1), and Taylor expansion using the source's p=O((1-rho)^2) estimate. Numerical root evaluations were used only as a sanity check, not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is a local one-sided expansion at rho=1 and does not give a global closed form for the optimal parameter curve. Only the quadratic and cubic coefficients are claimed. A cited 2010 thesis on analyticity and monotonicity of the critical parameter was located bibliographically but its full text was not available in the bounded literature search.
title: Exact quadratic tangency and cubic correction for the Koumandos–Ruscheweyh threshold
